content.comment_body: I'm having trouble getting the USB cable to work. I keep receiving a transmission error stating the port isn't available, no matter which port I use. I'm running macOS 10.5.8 with [product_name] V6.1. Am I missing something? Has anyone managed to get it working or experienced similar problems?
Hi, [user_name]. You can find relevant information in the FAQ section at [url].

From what I know, the driver provided on the CD and in the FAQ isn't compatible with Mac 10.5, only with 10.4. You should download the most recent driver directly from [url] as explained in the readme file. I've already downloaded it and attached it for you.

Thanks for the advice – I finally managed to get the USB cable working. For others with the same issue: 1) I repaired disk permissions using the disk utility; 2) I changed permissions in the /var folder to allow the current user to read and write; 3) I created a 'lock' folder inside /var with permissions for all users; 4) I reset the /var folder permissions for the current user; 5) I reinstalled the driver; 6) I rebooted the system.
Hello, I have macOS X 10.6.5 and [product_name] V6.1. I followed these steps but still can't get it to work. Hoping someone can help, thanks in advance.
In English: Hi all, I'm using macOS X 10.6.5 with [product_name] V6.1 and have followed the instructions but it's still not working for me. If anyone has suggestions, please let me know – thanks!

I'm experiencing the same problem – USB connection won't work. I've contacted the [company_name] support desk but it seems they're unfamiliar with Mac. I could use some help. I can't find the var/lock file and I'm unsure how to create it. This appears to be a major bug that [company_name] needs to address. Assistance in Dutch would be appreciated. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are consistently encountering issues with the USB cable when connecting Mac OS X systems to [product_name] software. Problems include transmission errors and driver incompatibility with newer Mac versions. Solutions involving manual changes to system folders have mixed results, and clear, consistent guidance appears lacking.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate seamless USB connectivity and straightforward driver installation for [product_name] on modern MacOS versions, seeking reliable instructions and support without needing advanced manual intervention.
